summary.text: Dane Watro is the Republican incumbent, in office since December 1, 2022, seeking re-election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 116, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his military service as U.S. Army.

paragraphs.text: Dane Watro Jr. graduated from Hazleton Area High School in 1995 and served in the U.S. Army.
After taking office on December 1, 2022, his 2023-2024 committee assignments, as listed by Ballotpedia, were Children & Youth, Local Government, and Veterans Affairs & Emergency Preparedness.
